name: limit-decoded-at-cap
description: A body that decodes to exactly the per-layer cap is accepted.
grounding: The cap is a limit, not a strict inequality. Implementations read one byte past it so that at-the-limit and over-it are distinguishable without a second read; this case pins which side of the boundary the equal case falls on.
notes: 50331648 = 48 MiB = MaxDecompressedBytes. Consumers generate these bytes rather than committing them; a 48 MiB blob is not reviewable and its compressed form is compressor-specific.
